items.title: Go2 exploration, patrol and navigation
items.summary: Integrate a quadruped navigation stack with mission logic and operator supervision for environmental inspection.
items.stack: Python; ROS 2; Nav2; LiDAR / Mid-360; SLAM integration; Jetson Orin NX; browser supervision
work: Mapping and navigation integration, patrol states, motion guards and recovery handling.

Edge-compute operation and inspection interfaces; some language/vision inference uses a server.
items.evidence: Go2 source workspace, deployment notes, incident records and the field-robotics inventory.
items.limits: Historical robot trials are not a measured industrial reliability guarantee. Full onboard VLM inference, physical gas localization and a completed Rust controller are not established here.
items.attribution: Builds on h-naderi/unitree-go2-slam-nav2, ROS 2, Nav2 and upstream SLAM components. Integration and evaluation are the represented work.

items.title: Mission and intervention accounting

items.limits: Private robot telemetry and the full integration test suite are not exported. Accounting rules depend on the quality of event instrumentation.
items.attribution: Project analysis module, with selected test imports adapted for this repository.
